events.title: Wormhole bridge is exploited
events.summary: An attacker exploited Wormhole's Solana-side verification logic and minted 120,000 unbacked wrapped ETH, worth roughly $320-$325 million at the time; Wormhole subsequently restored backing.
events.significance: The exploit became one of the largest bridge failures in crypto history and exposed the systemic security risk created by cross-chain message verification.

sources.title: CertiK — Wormhole Bridge Exploit Incident Analysis

events.notes: Add Wormhole first-party postmortem before VERIFIED.

events.title: Ronin bridge loses 173,600 ETH and 25.5 million USDC
events.summary: Attackers drained 173,600 ETH and 25.5 million USDC from the Ronin bridge after compromising validator keys.
events.significance: The exploit was one of crypto's largest thefts and directly struck Axie Infinity's play-to-earn economy.

sources.title: Ronin — The Ronin Bridge Is Open

events.title: UST loses its dollar peg
events.summary: TerraUSD (UST) lost its dollar peg in May 2022 and collapsed toward zero.
events.significance: The failure destroyed confidence in the Terra ecosystem and became the defining algorithmic-stablecoin collapse.

sources.title: SEC — Terraform Labs and Do Kwon complaint summary

events.title: LUNA enters a death spiral
events.summary: As UST lost its peg, the associated LUNA token collapsed toward zero while supply expanded dramatically through the stabilization mechanism.
events.significance: The death spiral wiped out one of crypto's largest ecosystems and triggered losses across lenders, funds and retail investors.

sources.title: SEC — Terraform Labs and Do Kwon

events.title: Anchor's high-yield stablecoin model collapses with Terra
events.summary: Anchor Protocol's yield-bearing UST product collapsed alongside UST and LUNA after having been marketed with yields as high as roughly 20%.
events.significance: Anchor's failure showed how subsidized stablecoin yields can create systemic demand and fragility at enormous scale.

sources.title: SEC — Terraform Labs and Do Kwon

events.title: Celsius freezes withdrawals
events.summary: Celsius halted customer withdrawals and transfers on 12 June 2022 amid severe liquidity problems.
events.significance: The freeze became one of the clearest public signs that the 2022 crypto credit crisis had spread from token markets into major centralized lenders.

events.title: Three Arrows Capital collapses
events.summary: Crypto hedge fund Three Arrows Capital entered insolvency proceedings in mid-2022 after heavy losses and leveraged exposures.
events.significance: 3AC's collapse transmitted losses into lenders and counterparties, making it a central node in the 2022 contagion chain.

events.title: Voyager Digital enters bankruptcy
events.summary: Voyager Digital entered bankruptcy proceedings in July 2022 after losses and counterparty failures during the credit crisis.
events.significance: Voyager showed how 3AC-linked losses propagated from a hedge fund into retail-facing crypto lenders.

events.title: Nomad bridge is drained in a copycat exploit
events.summary: Nomad suffered a bridge exploit in August 2022 that became notorious because multiple addresses copied the exploit transaction pattern to withdraw assets.
events.significance: The incident became the canonical 'crowdsourced' bridge hack and demonstrated how transparent exploit mechanics can accelerate losses.

events.title: US Treasury sanctions Tornado Cash
events.summary: The US Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control sanctioned Tornado Cash on 8 August 2022.
events.significance: The action created a landmark conflict over sanctions, privacy infrastructure, smart contracts and whether immutable code can be a sanctions target.

events.title: Ethereum completes The Merge
events.summary: Ethereum's Paris upgrade activated on 15 September 2022, merging mainnet execution with Beacon Chain proof-of-stake consensus and ending proof-of-work mining.
events.significance: The Merge was one of blockchain history's largest live consensus transitions and cut Ethereum's energy use by roughly 99.95%.

events.title: Ethereum proof-of-work mining ends
events.summary: The Merge switched off Ethereum's proof-of-work consensus and transferred network security to validators staking ETH.
events.significance: GPU mining ceased to secure Ethereum, ending a seven-year mining era and forcing miners toward other chains or other uses.

events.title: BNB Chain bridge exploit mints two million BNB
events.summary: An attacker exploited the BSC Token Hub cross-chain bridge, creating two million BNB through forged proof verification.
events.significance: The incident raised major questions about bridge security and chain governance after validators coordinated a temporary network pause.

events.title: Mango Markets is manipulated and drained
events.summary: Avraham Eisenberg used two controlled accounts and large MNGO trades to manipulate the price of MNGO perpetuals, inflate collateral value and withdraw roughly $110-$116 million in crypto from Mango Markets.
events.significance: The incident became a landmark DeFi market-manipulation case and tested whether actions executed through protocol rules could still constitute fraud and commodities manipulation.

sources.title: SEC — Charges Avraham Eisenberg over Mango Markets manipulation

events.notes: Later criminal and civil cases provide the strongest authoritative reconstruction of the 11 October 2022 event.

events.title: CoinDesk publishes Alameda balance-sheet scoop
events.summary: CoinDesk reported that a private Alameda Research balance sheet showed a large concentration of assets in FTX's own FTT token.
events.significance: The report triggered scrutiny of the financial ties between Alameda and FTX and became the opening event in the exchange's public collapse.

events.title: CZ announces Binance will liquidate its FTT holdings
events.summary: Binance CEO Changpeng Zhao said Binance had decided to liquidate its remaining FTT holdings after 'recent revelations' and described the move as post-exit risk management following lessons from LUNA.
events.significance: The public announcement accelerated scrutiny and withdrawals at FTX during the sequence that ended in its bankruptcy five days later; it should be treated as a catalyst in a broader solvency crisis, not the sole cause.

sources.title: Binance Square recap of CZ FTT announcement

events.notes: Causal wording is deliberately limited: FTX's underlying balance-sheet and customer-fund problems predated the tweet.

events.title: Binance signs a non-binding deal to acquire FTX
events.summary: FTX and Binance announced a non-binding letter of intent under which Binance would explore acquiring FTX.com amid a severe liquidity crisis.
events.significance: For a few hours, the proposed rescue appeared to offer FTX a path out of collapse; its failure made the scale of the problem unmistakable.

events.title: Binance abandons the FTX acquisition
events.summary: Binance said it would not pursue the FTX acquisition after due diligence and reports concerning customer funds and investigations.
events.significance: The withdrawal removed FTX's most plausible immediate rescue and made bankruptcy increasingly unavoidable.

sources.title: Binance channel — withdrawal from FTX deal

events.title: FTX files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
events.summary: FTX Trading and more than 100 affiliated entities filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in Delaware on 11 November 2022.
events.significance: The bankruptcy of one of the world's largest crypto exchanges became the defining institutional collapse of the 2022 bear market.

sources.title: U.S. Trustee Program report — FTX bankruptcy

events.title: FTX collapse exposes diversion of customer funds to Alameda
events.summary: US regulators later alleged that FTX customer assets had been diverted to Alameda Research and that Alameda received undisclosed special treatment on FTX.
events.significance: The allegations transformed FTX from a liquidity failure story into one of the largest alleged frauds in financial-technology history.

events.title: BlockFi files for bankruptcy after FTX contagion
events.summary: BlockFi entered Chapter 11 bankruptcy in late November 2022 after the FTX collapse severely damaged its liquidity and financial position.
events.significance: BlockFi's failure showed how FTX contagion spread into centralized lending almost immediately.

events.title: Sam Bankman-Fried is arrested in the Bahamas
events.summary: Bankman-Fried was arrested in the Bahamas on 12 December 2022 ahead of US criminal and civil charges.
events.significance: The arrest closed the first phase of the FTX collapse and began the criminal-prosecution chapter.

events.title: US regulators charge Sam Bankman-Fried
events.summary: The SEC charged Bankman-Fried with defrauding FTX equity investors while US prosecutors announced a criminal indictment including fraud, money-laundering and campaign-finance offenses.
events.significance: The coordinated charges formally alleged that FTX's collapse involved years-long misuse of customer assets rather than mere mismanagement.

events.title: The crypto credit contagion links Terra, 3AC, Celsius, Voyager, BlockFi and FTX
events.summary: During 2022, failures and losses propagated through a highly interconnected network of hedge funds, lenders and exchanges, including Terra, Three Arrows, Celsius, Voyager, BlockFi and FTX.
events.significance: The contagion revealed hidden leverage and counterparty concentration across centralized crypto credit markets.

sources.title: SEC filing — Celsius, Voyager, 3AC and Terra
